claims.evidence: Witness could not confirm generation/version (disc vs digital) or regional variant from the two photos; only a generic PlayStation logo is visible.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 both show one white controller leaning against the console base.
Only a single controller is visible in both photos; no second pad shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Internal state and casing seals are not visible in the photos.
Thermal/functional performance cannot be assessed from static photos.
Ports are not shown in use or tested in either photo.
No receipt or paperwork appears in either photo.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault
risks.proof: Video of console powering on, showing home screen and a game loading

risks.risk: Port damage (HDMI, USB, power) not visible in static photos
risks.proof: Video showing cables plugged in and working (power, HDMI output, controller charging)
risks.if_unproven: priced as ports unverified, risk of needing repair

risks.risk: Overheating or internal dust/thermal paste degradation
risks.proof: Video of console running under load for 15+ minutes with fan noise audible

risks.risk: Edition/generation mismatch (disc vs digital, UK vs other region) affecting resale value
risks.proof: Clear photo of disc slot and rear regional label/serial sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced at lower-spec worst case (digital edition, unconfirmed region)

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, second controller, box)
risks.proof: Photo of all included items laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as console + single controller only, no extras

risks.proof: Clear photo of the actual UK purchase receipt with date and retailer
risks.if_unproven: priced as no proof of purchase, no warranty assumed

risks.risk: Hidden prior repair or opened casing (voids 'never opened' claim)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of screws/seals on the underside of the console
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly repaired/opened, standard used risk

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and running a game for several minutes
Close-up of disc slot and rear label showing model/serial number
Photo of all included accessories (cables, controller(s), box) laid out together
Clear photo of the UK receipt
Close-up of underside screws/seals to confirm casing never opened
response.reason: The witness confirms a PlayStation console with one controller, so it can be priced at worst case for an unverified model/edition with only a single pad; several seller claims (condition, ports, overheating, extra pad, receipt) remain unverifiable remotely and do not block pricing.
